description: This file defines Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) related to order operations in a Kotlin-based frontend project. It includes data classes for order items, orders, and order creation requests, designed to match backend API schemas for order management.

classes.name: OrderItemDto
classes.description: Represents an individual item in an order, including product ID, name, unit price, and quantity.

classes.name: OrderDto
classes.description: Represents an entire order, including order ID, email, status, list of items, total amount, and timestamps.

classes.name: OrderCreateItemRequestDto
classes.description: Represents a request to create an order item, specifying product ID and quantity.

classes.name: OrderCreateRequestDto
classes.description: Represents a request to create an order, including optional contact, coupon, payment info, and list of order items.
